note: Per-FILE registration of tests and records that reference the A0 delete set. A directory is never exempt: a new referrer must either be rewired or registered here in review. subject=retired-module retires with its subject; subject=replaced-entry must be re-pointed at the new entry in A1, not deleted; subject=evidence-record is a historical record, executed by no CI leg. Registration does NOT drop a capability — see 06-CAPABILITY-CONTRACT.md.

retiredSubjects.note: Per-FILE retirement record for suites whose SUBJECT the A0/A1 cut removed.
